methodology.label: 價格與成交額市場偏好代理指標（非實際資金淨流入）
methodology.universe: S&P 500 + Nasdaq-100 securities, overlapping tickers de-duplicated
methodology.price_field: Yahoo Finance Adj Close; split and dividend adjusted
methodology.score_meaning: Cross-sectional percentile score from 0 to 100; relative ranking, not valuation.

quadrant.x: 20-session equal-weight relative return versus the combined universe
quadrant.y: 5-session relative-return acceleration versus the preceding 5 sessions

methodology.breadth: Average of positive 20-session return share and share above 20-session moving average.
methodology.volume: Latest 5-session aggregate traded-dollar average versus the preceding 20 sessions.
methodology.leadership_gap: 20-session dollar-liquidity-weighted return minus equal-weight return; not market-cap weighting.
